subject: Pilot MAP & Q3 evaluation — discount request and approval path
messages:
From: Alex Bennett <abennett@northpoint.health>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP + timeline for Q3 evaluation

Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Northpoint is excited about Redwood's inference performance. We want to move quickly: our internal stakeholders (Infra, Product, Procurement) have agreed to a 4-week pilot to validate latency and cost metrics before a broader rollout.

High-level asks:
- 4-week evaluation (pilot) starting mid-May
- Pilot scope: 50k tokens/day, evaluation metrics: 99th perc latency, cost per 1k tokens, output parity checks
- We are asking for a concession on the pilot price given this is a timeboxed eval; target pilot fee: $3,500 (noted in procurement)
- If the pilot meets milestones (MAP milestone 1: integration by week 1; milestone 2: perf targets met by week 3), Northpoint will commit to a phased Dedicated deployment within 90 days and a 12-month minimum ARR commit.

Can you share a MAP and a one-page SOW + pricing? Procurement would like commercial terms by EOD Tuesday (May 4) if possible.

Regards,
Alex Bennett
Dir. of Platform Engineering | Northpoint Health
abennett@northpoint.health

---
Attachment: northpoint_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Bennett <abennett@northpoint.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + timeline for Q3 evaluation

Alex — thanks, and great to hear the team wants to move fast. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a one-page SOW for the 4-week pilot. Summary below:

Proposed pilot pricing (standard): $6,000 for 4 weeks (includes 24/7 infra monitoring, support SLOs, and 50k tokens/day cap).
Proposed pilot concession: 30% off ($4,200) if Northpoint signs the attached MAP committing to the phased Dedicated deployment within 90 days and a 12-month minimum ARR commit.

Key MAP milestones (draft):
- Week 1: Integration + test traffic (validation checklist)
- Week 2–3: Perf validation (99th perc, throughput)
- Week 4: Final evaluation + executive review

We can do the 30% concession but that requires internal approval for discounts beyond our standard 15% pilot allowance. I'm looping in Aditya (VP Sales) and Rafael (Legal/Rev Ops) for approvals and to finalize the SOW & contract language.

Next steps: please review attachments and confirm you can sign the MAP by EOD May 6 to keep the mid-May start.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Attachments: northpoint_map_v1.pdf; northpoint_sow_draft.docx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot MAP + timeline for Q3 evaluation — discount ask (Northpoint)

Aditya / Rafael — forwarding Northpoint's ask. They requested a $3.5k pilot fee; we proposed $6k standard / $4.2k with a 30% concession in exchange for a 90-day ramp commit + 12-month ARR.

Why I think we should approve:
- Strategic customer in the health vertical with potential for significant ARR across several business units
- Short pilot window, low ramp risk if perf targets met
- Concession tied to a firm ramp + term reduces downside

Open question: 30% is above our pre-approved pilot discount (15%). Would like approval to offer up to 30% but with conditions: MAP milestones, minimum ARR commit, and repayment clause if customer churns within first 6 months. Rafael, can Legal encode the repayment clause in the SOW?

Thanks — Hannah

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot MAP + timeline for Q3 evaluation — discount ask (Northpoint)

Hannah — thanks for the context. I support making a commercial concession to win this anchor account, but we should be careful with depth of discount absent firm commitments. My recommendation: counter at 25% off pilot fee (pilot = $4,500) conditioned on:
- Signed MAP with milestones and approval gates
- Executive sponsor from Northpoint committing to the 90-day Dedicated evaluation and an intent to move to a 12-month minimum ARR
- A clause that allows us to recoup net concession if they cancel within 6 months (prorated credit)

Marcus — looping you for finance sign-off on anything >20% off standard pilot pricing. Rafael, please prep the SOW language and the recoupment mechanism.

-Aditya

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP — discount approval threshold

Team — I reviewed the customer profile and expected ramp economics. Finance can approve a 25% concession on the pilot (bringing their pilot fee to $4,500) provided we get:
1) A signed MAP with explicit milestones and acceptance criteria;
2) A minimum 12-month ARR commitment or a signed Letter of Intent that the C-suite approves the phased Dedicated roll-out within 90 days;
3) A repayment clause in the SOW: if Northpoint terminates or fails to scale to at least 50% of the committed ARR within 6 months, we recoup the concession on a prorated basis.

Rafael — please work with Legal to ensure the SOW and DocuSign flow captures this. Hannah / Aditya — once Legal has the clause, you can share final terms with the customer.

-Marcus Lin
CFO | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Bennett <abennett@northpoint.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Pilot MAP & conditional discount (Northpoint)

Alex — quick update and next steps. Finance has approved a 25% pilot concession (pilot fee $4,500) conditional on the MAP milestones and SOW repayment language. Rafael has the SOW draft and will add the recoupment clause Marcus requested.

Action items / timeline:
- Rafael (Legal) to update SOW and send DocuSign by EOD May 9
- Northpoint to sign MAP + SOW by May 12 to enable a May 17 pilot start
- Integration checklist (week 1) and perf validation (weeks 2–3) to be executed as in the MAP

If that works, we’ll send the updated SOW + MAP links and a DocuSign to Jordan and Legal at Northpoint.

Thanks and happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the repayment mechanics.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
